cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Enter on My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit them into your side of a contest or bargain before the stakes become fully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've copied your raised bid at the fete auction. Put your name on my bidding slip; we'll take the lot together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was waving at my daughter. You've bought the entire jam stall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, whole stall. Put your name beside mine and we'll agree who takes what.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The stall includes tomorrow's shift. I promised my daughter we'd go swimming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign for the stock with me first. We can divide tomorrow up once it's ours.

reason: Rebuild the same-holder combination around an actual misread confident behavior and a concrete Drive request. Give B's correction or offer control over the next tactic.
